about: The one list of scan roots (phase 0 review round 2, adversarial finding 13). Every folder at the top of the repository, under packages/<pkg>/ and under services/<service>/ is either scanned (with the scans that read it) or excluded (with the reason). The scan-roots check fails on a folder that is neither, and pnpm lint:deps cruises the lint:deps roots named here. See tools/checks/scan-roots/README.md.

scans.lint:deps: dependency-cruiser with .dependency-cruiser.cjs: pnpm lint:deps (tools/checks/scan-roots/lint-deps.ts) and the boundary run of the lint-bans check
scans.lint-bans: the SOVITECH ESLint bans with inline disables off, and the HTML scan (tools/checks/lint-bans/)
scans.reserved-terms: the reserved-term check (tools/checks/reserved-terms/; guardrails 2.8: UI strings, templates, seeds)
scans.mockup-figures: the mockup-figure check (tools/checks/mockup-figures/; prompt 3 section 14 item 3)
scans.python-bans: the extractor's number and zero bans (services/extractor/tests/test_bans.py, run by pnpm test:py)
scans.ruff-pytest: ruff check, ruff format and pytest on the service folder (pnpm test:py)

packages.note: Each packages/<pkg>/ subfolder is classified under packageSubfolders.

services.note: Each services/<service>/ subfolder is classified under serviceSubfolders.

.claude.excluded: Claude Code settings, project skills and agents: not app code. The version-sync check reads each SKILL.md and the config-exclusion check reads the configs, file by file.

design.excluded: Approved design screenshots and the specs: the brief for people, not code or copy the app ships (CLAUDE.md, "Where things are").

docs.excluded: Guardrails, product documents, ADRs and the build log: rules and records, not code or copy the app ships. The index, version-sync and loosening checks read the files they need.

prompts.excluded: The in-app AI prompt: the version-sync check reads its header, and the guardrail evals cover its behaviour (CLAUDE.md, definition of done item 2).

company.excluded: Company knowledge imported from the website: never an input to the app, any config or any scan (build-readiness decision 12; prompt 3 section 6).

node_modules.excluded: Installed npm packages, not the repository's own content.

.venv.excluded: A Python virtual environment: installed packages, not the repository's own content.

.pnpm-store.excluded: The pnpm package store CI caches (.gitlab-ci.yml): installed packages.

.cache.excluded: Caches, such as the Playwright browsers CI keeps (.gitlab-ci.yml): installed files.

test-results.excluded: Generated output of the Playwright and render runs (git-ignored).

playwright-report.excluded: Generated output of the Playwright runs (git-ignored).

.vscode.excluded: Editor settings on a developer's machine: not part of the repository's content.

.idea.excluded: Editor settings on a developer's machine: not part of the repository's content.

gates.note: Gate records (prompt 3 section 5.4): data read by the registry and the loosening check.

test-formulas.note: The engine's TEST formulas (prompt 3 section 6; phase 5).

node_modules.excluded: Installed npm packages and pnpm's links to the workspace packages.

schemas.note: Third-party standard schemas with their source and SHA-256 (the IDS 1.0 XSD; ADR 0018).

.venv.excluded: The service's Python virtual environment, installed from the hashed lock: not the repository's own content.
